NOM-01.output:
Here's the `FeedPage.css` file. A few notes on the structure:

- **`@layer components`** wraps all rules per the constraint.
- **No margin** on any element — the constraint bars component-owned margins; centering/spacing is the parent's job.
- **No resets** (margin: 0, padding: 0, list-style: none) — those belong in `@layer base`.
- All values reference `--shelf-feedPage-*` and `--shelf-feedItem-*` component-tier tokens. You'll need to define these in `tokens.css` (including dark-mode blocks) before the styles resolve.

The matching component file (`FeedPage.tsx`) would use class names `.feed-page`, `.feed-page-heading`, `.feed-item`, `.feed-item-title`, and `.feed-item-description`.
